businessGoal: Allow users to filter products by brand to find relevant items more easily.

scenarios.goal: Verify that brand filter checkboxes are displayed in the sidebar.
Verify that selecting one or more brand checkboxes updates the product grid to show only products from the selected brands.
Verify that selecting both categories and brands filters the product grid to show only products matching both criteria.

manual.reason: The story involves UI interactions and functionality related to product filtering.

api.reason: The filtering behavior can be validated through available APIs based on brand and category parameters.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe interactions with the UI elements, such as checkboxes and product grid updates.
